Word Sentences.answer:
forgiveness: letting go of your grudge against someone; I showed forgiveness when my friend said sorry.
invent: to create something that never existed before; Scientists invent new machines.
responsibility: the duty to take care of someone or something; Feeding our pet is my responsibility.
cherish: to keep something close to your heart and value it; I cherish the gift from my friend.
ingredient: a part of any mixture or preparation, like in cooking; Sugar is an ingredient in the cake.
democracy: a system of government where people vote to make decisions; In a democracy, people vote for their leaders.

Paragraph Writing.answer: A good paragraph has a topic sentence, three to five supporting sentences with facts or ideas about the chosen topic, and a concluding sentence. For example, on Recycling: It is a way to use things again; we sort paper, cans and bottles; recycling saves trees and energy; it keeps our planet clean; conclusion.

accept: Any one of the three topics
Present tense or past tense used consistently

points.text: A clear topic sentence that introduces the chosen topic
Three to five relevant supporting sentences with facts or ideas
A concluding sentence that wraps up the idea
Sentences are in order and stay on the topic
Correct grammar, spelling, capitalisation and punctuation

scheme.common_error: Writing separate unconnected sentences with no topic sentence or conclusion

Yours obediently or Yours sincerely

Comprehension Passage.passage: Every Saturday morning, Sana and her brother Bilal walked to the empty plot behind their school. The plot was full of dry grass and old plastic bottles. Mr. Khan, the school gardener, had asked the children to help him make a small garden there. Sana collected the bottles in a big bag, and Bilal pulled out the weeds. Then Mr. Khan gave them seeds of tomatoes and beans. The children dug small holes and planted the seeds carefully. Every day they watered the plants with a bucket. After a month, green leaves appeared. Bilal shouted with joy when he saw the first tiny tomato. Sana smiled proudly. Soon the whole school came to see the garden, and the students promised to take care of it together.
Comprehension Passage.main_question: Read the passage and answer the questions
